turns.text: Hello. How long does delivery take to another EU country, and do you take cash on delivery?

Delivery to other EU countries takes 5 to 8 working days. We take card payments only and do not offer cash on delivery. I also passed this chat to a colleague by mistake, so they may contact you. You don't need to do anything. I can still help with anything else you need.

rule.ro: Livrarea durează 1–2 zile lucrătoare în România și 5–8 zile lucrătoare în celelalte țări din Uniunea Europeană.
rule.en: Delivery takes 1 to 2 working days in Romania and 5 to 8 working days in other EU countries.

rule.ro: Plata se face doar cu cardul. Magazinul nu oferă plata ramburs.
rule.en: Payment is by card only. The shop does not offer cash on delivery.
